neighbours.label: Subject-start word (determiner/demonstrative/noun like 'these', 'each', 'today', 'the trend') right after a causal connective 'so' / 'therefore,' where a main verb is expected next
fire: The old cables kept fraying at the joints, so these replacements are braided with nylon.
Ticket prices doubled over the summer; therefore, each family now buys only one pass.
The coach wanted a faster lineup this season, so the starters run sprints every morning.
Interest rates climbed for six straight quarters, and so the housing market cooled considerably.
The museum lost its funding last spring, so today volunteers staff the front desk.
Our garden gets almost no afternoon sun; therefore, those tomatoes never fully ripen.
The original recipe was far too salty for the kids, so this version uses half the soy sauce.
Several students missed the field trip because of illness, so a makeup visit was scheduled in May.
quiet: The old cables kept fraying at the joints, even though these replacements cost twice as much.
Ticket prices doubled over the summer, and each family complained loudly at the gate.
The coach wanted a faster lineup this season and hired a sprint trainer from the college.
Interest rates climbed for six straight quarters while the housing market kept setting records.
The museum lost its funding last spring, yet today it still opens its doors at nine.
Our garden gets almost no afternoon sun, which is why those tomatoes are grown in pots.
The original recipe was far too salty for the kids, who preferred this version with honey.
Several students missed the field trip because of illness, and a nurse checked on them later.
